office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital, and transportation budgets, serving a two-year term.
race_blurb: Incumbent Democrat Lauren Davis, known for behavioral-health legislation, faces fellow Democrat Imraan Siddiqi, executive director of CAIR-Washington, who runs on immigrant protection and affordability. The local party dual-endorsed both.

candidates.summary: State Representative since 2019 whose record centers on addiction and behavioral-health policy, including Ricky's Law and the Recovery Navigator Program.
highlights: Passed Ricky's Law and created the Recovery Navigator Program and the Lynnwood Crisis Care Center [S1]
Voted for ESSB 6346 (2026 income tax over $1 million) and was an original sponsor of ESHB 1296 [S5][S7]
Says she is "completely pro-choice" and has championed health care for immigrants and protections against ICE [S1]

taxes.basis: Voted for the 2026 tax on income over $1 million; no campaign statements on taxes found.

spending.basis: Calls for game-changing investments in education and treatment on demand.

housing.basis: Voted for rent stabilization and prioritizes supportive and affordable housing.

safety.basis: Record combines involuntary addiction treatment (Ricky's Law) with diversion and treatment programs; endorsed by police guilds and progressive groups.

experience.basis: Incumbent since 2019 with a substantial enacted behavioral-health record.

immigration.basis: Says she has championed health care for immigrants and protections against ICE.

social.basis: States she is completely pro-choice; endorsed by Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates.

parental-rights.basis: Original sponsor of, and yes vote on, ESHB 1296, which amended the I-2081 parental-rights list.

candidates.summary: First-time candidate and executive director of CAIR-Washington running on immigrant protection, affordability, and taxing the wealthiest.
highlights: Executive director of CAIR-Washington and one of the original plaintiffs against the Muslim ban [S1]
Would fund legal defense for immigrants and keep state institutions from facilitating federal enforcement [S3]
Calls for progressive revenue so the wealthiest pay their fair share [S3]

taxes.basis: States he will support progressive revenue to make the wealthiest pay their fair share.

spending.basis: Wants to invest in affordability and expand access to services.

housing.basis: Pairs more housing near transit with stronger renter protections and anti-displacement measures.

experience.basis: No elected experience; civil-rights organizer challenging an eight-year incumbent.

immigration.basis: Immigrant protection is a core plank: legal defense funding, due process, and no state facilitation of federal enforcement.

social.basis: Pledges to fight harmful legislation aimed at LGBTQIA+ and other communities; endorsed by Stonewall Democrats.
